description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants - The Amendments to SLFRSs w.e.f. 01.01.2017
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the adoption of amendments to Sri Lanka Financial Reporting Standards (SLFRSs) and Lanka Accounting Standards (LKAS), specifically LKAS 7 and LKAS 12. It involves the publication of new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for accounting practices under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory amendments.
